R316.note: Build fails (unused accountID in GetCSRFTokenHandler), and even if it compiled the new tokenStore field is never initialised so every request would nil-dereference on RLock - the endpoint silently stops working and the write-up says nothing about constructing the store.

R317.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities() on both interpolated values in an HTML body context; output otherwise unchanged.

R318.note: GUID filename plus .cshtml allowlist closes the traversal write, but the stored name returned to the admin changes from their filename to a GUID and re-uploading the same template no longer replaces it - the rename is shown but its effect on later lookup of the template by name is not addressed.

R319.note: Unsigned index checked against MAX_PLAYERS before the write; out-of-range updates are dropped, which is the only sane behaviour for a previously-UB path.

R320.note: The handler now checks for an 'authorization-role: admin' metadata value that any caller can set themselves, so the check is trivially bypassable as written (the write-up acknowledges it is a placeholder for real token validation), and the added interceptor is a no-op; the new admin requirement is stated plainly.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default fully escapes quote/backslash/angle-bracket breakouts (verified in a scratch .NET run), but Encode(null) throws ArgumentNullException (also verified), so a request without ?q= now errors where the original emitted an empty string; the 'no additional dependencies' claim is also wrong for .NET Framework Web Forms, where System.Text.Encodings.Web is a NuGet package.

R322.note: Index checked against calibrationTable.size() before operator[]; out-of-range returns the raw reading, matching the existing short-length path.

R323.note: PDO prepare/execute with a positional placeholder; return values and the 404 path are preserved.

R324.note: filepath.IsLocal plus a separator-aware prefix check against an absolute base closes Zip Slip while still allowing nested entries; the comment that IsLocal rejects '/' elements is inaccurate but the code is correct.

R325.note: Moving the delete to a POST-only view puts it under CsrfViewMiddleware, but the write-up ships no urls.py route for delete_account_confirm and no delete_confirm.html, so as delivered the confirmation page 500s and deletion is unreachable; the template need is stated, the missing route is not.

R326.note: queryForObject with a ? placeholder and orderNumber as a bind argument; semantics otherwise identical.

R327.note: sendFile with the root option makes send reject any '..' segment (403) and confine resolution to reportsDir; legitimate names and subpaths still resolve as before.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is the appropriate API for keeping HTML rendering; the cited CVE-2026-41238 / 3.4.0 floor cannot be verified from the case and should be checked against the advisory before relying on it.
